author: IamSUPERMAN2007
body:
So this has been suggested a long time ago by NolanDalton. I thought it would be quite helpful for mods.

Command: /infractions [Name]

"This is a command for mods that displays the infractions of the user. This could help if they are deciding between a kick or a tempban for a punishment." (Quote by Nolan)

Ex:

Noob's infractions
---------------------------------------------
[Kick] Spamming 05/08/2014
[T-ban] Team spleefing 20/07/2014
[Kick] Team spleefing 20/07/2014
-------------------------------------------------

replies.author: Lieutenantpants
replies.body: Please. I've seen many people receive the same base infraction (warn or kick) several times for the same offense, when the punishment should have become more severe. It's simply impractical to have to look up their infraction's on the website every time staff deals an infraction, so I definitely support this. This would make moderating far more efficient.
